Index dosing intervals

Source: R/nif_class.R
index_dosing_interval.Rd

This function adds a column 'DI' that indicates the dosing interval per parent. All baseline observations before the first dosing interval get assigned to the first dosing interval.

Usage

index_dosing_interval(obj, parent = NULL)

Arguments

obj

The NIF object.

parent

The treatments to filter for. Defaults to all parents, if NULL.

Value

A NIF object with the DI column added.

Examples

index_dosing_interval(examplinib_fe_nif)
